description: Our house hot chocolate mix is built from a blend of dark and milk cocoas, ground fine enough to melt seamlessly into hot milk without any grit or chalkiness.
It's the same recipe served in the salon, just for home — whisk two spoonfuls into a cup of warm milk and finish with a spoon of whipped cream for the full Maison ritual.

specs.label: Best enjoyed
specs.value: Same day, with a cup of hot chocolate

specs.label: Taste
specs.value: Chestnut cream, light meringue, soft whipped cream

description: The Mont-Blanc is our most requested signature — a crisp meringue base layered with whipped cream and finished with fine strands of piped chestnut purée.
Each one is piped to order by hand in the kitchen. Best enjoyed the same day, ideally seated, with a spoon and no rush.
Crisp on the outside, soft in the center — our macaron box brings together four of the collection's most popular flavors in one gift-ready set.
Keep them refrigerated and bring to room temperature about 15 minutes before serving for the best texture.

specs.label: Taste
specs.value: Dark chocolate, delicate crunch, light bitterness

description: A textural favorite — thin, crisp crepe pieces enrobed in dark chocolate, snapped into small squares for easy sharing.
Store in a cool, dry place. They pair particularly well with a pot of black tea in the afternoon.
Small, gold-wrapped bites of gianduja — a classic hazelnut-and-chocolate paste, pressed into bite-sized pieces and finished with a light dusting of cocoa.
The tin is designed to be reused once empty, and travels well as a gift.

specs.label: Taste
specs.value: Butter caramel, sea salt, soft vanilla finish

description: Soft-set caramels made with brown butter and a touch of sea salt, finished with a whisper of vanilla to round out the sweetness.
Best kept in a cool room rather than the refrigerator, which can dull the texture.

specs.label: Taste
specs.value: Praline, milk chocolate, roasted nut finish

description: Our praline box pairs a crunchy roasted-nut praline core with a milk chocolate shell, boxed in the Maison's signature heart-shaped case.
A favorite for gifting — the box alone is often kept and reused long after the pralines are gone.
A sampler box built to introduce the tea list — a rotating mix of our oolong and black tea blends, each individually sachet-wrapped for freshness.
A good starting point if you're not sure which loose-leaf tin to commit to next.
The same chestnut cream piped onto our Mont-Blanc, jarred for spreading — smooth, lightly sweet, and best on warm toasted brioche.
Stir before opening if any natural separation has occurred; this is normal and doesn't affect the flavor.
A single-origin oolong selected for its floral aromatics and smooth, honeyed finish — served in the salon and now available loose in a resealable tin.
Re-steeps well; the second infusion often reveals notes the first pass misses.

description: Our largest gifting box, bringing together the full range of the chocolate collection — pralines, soft ganaches, and pure dark chocolate pieces.
Comes with a printed guide inside the lid so you know what you're picking up before you bite.
